datasets.name: ODS_CMACTIVE
datasets.sql:
select k.numberofcredit as "muqavile no-su", f.name filial,  
b.name as "borcalan", j.val_name valyuta, v.acc_no as "ssuda hesabi" , 
mehman.getdailypayment(k.id, :v_paydate) as "odenen mebleg",
round(mehman.getdailypayment(k.id , :v_paydate)*s.ostat,2) as "odenen meblegin ekv",
 k.annualyinterestrate||'%' as "illik faiz",
mehman2.given(k.id, :k_givendate ) as "verilen mebleg",
round (mehman2.given(k.id, :k_givendate)*s.ostat, 2) as "verilen meblegin ekv",
round (months_between (k.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,k.DATEOFCONCLUSION),0)  as "kreditin muddeti(ayla)",
h.rest+h.duerest  as "gun sonuna qaliq" ,
round((h.rest+h.duerest)*s.ostat, 2) as "qaligin ekv",
k.purposeofcredit as "kredit mehsulunun adi"
 from
cm_active_credits k,  cm_boorowerinfo b, sb_filial f, sb_avalute j,
cm_loanaccounts v, smart.temprate s,cm_history h
   where
 k.id=b.creditid and k.branchid=f.id and k.currency=j.valute 
and k.id=v.creditid and k.currency=s.val_kod and k.id=h.creditid and
 hdate=(:h_date)
